feedback: Accepted. Format: exact paper artifact shape (STATES, INITIAL_STATE, nonempty FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION with per-state else self-loops, REWARD_FUNCTION keyed by (state, proposition, next_state)); FINAL_STATES u4 is declared and is accepting for the task, entered exactly on target_picked_up, the mission-completing event that ends the episode. Semantic fidelity: the task is the response property 'whenever the ball is away, the key is in hand at that moment or afterwards'. Because the first ball-away step is necessarily a ball pickup (hands full, so has_door_key is false at that step), the 'at that moment' case can only occur at later ball-away steps; state u1 ('ball has been away, key not yet held since') encodes the pending obligation, and (u1, has_door_key) discharges it at the first key-in-hand step afterwards. That discharge is guaranteed in every completing trace: the toggle step requires the matching key in hand while standing where the ball was, i.e., blocker_moved true, so no violating trace can reach u4 and the RM never rewards non-compliance. Key-first prefixes (a legal order, 149/300 episodes pick the key first) are absorbed by the u0 else self-loop without stalling or premature obligation, and the key milestone reward correctly lands on the post-blocker re-acquisition. Regressions: none required. Ball return (blocker_moved false again) and key loss (key_lost, door closed) are absorbed by else self-loops; re-arming to u0 or u1 on them would let the agent re-earn blocker/key rewards (farming) and would wrongly condemn the canonical trace where the key is dropped after the door opens and never re-held — under the stated reading that obligation is already discharged. Event/condition kinds are respected: key_lost (an event) is correctly never used as a transition trigger and is covered by else self-loops in all five states; conditions are used as levels. Only the five given propositions appear — blocker_moved rather than the old published has_ball alias. Reward safety: the chain is monotone, each milestone pays once, no negative rewards, total bounded at 1.3 (0.1 x 3 progress plus 1.0 terminal), dense across the four real progress points of the domain, and no partial-farming path beyond 0.3 without completion. All five states are reachable and no compliant trace deadlocks; out-of-order or irrelevant propositions (door_open in u0/u1/u3, has_door_key in u0/u2/u3, key_lost, no-ops) all fall through to defined else self-loops.
